questions.body_en: Study the number array below. In Mathematics, a prime number has only 2 factors – 1 and itself. The prime numbers in the array, up to 19, have been circled. What is the second prime number that is bigger than 60?
questions.body_id: Perhatikan susunan bilangan di bawah ini. Dalam Matematika, bilangan prima hanya memiliki 2 faktor – 1 dan dirinya sendiri. Bilangan prima dalam susunan, hingga 19, telah dilingkari. Apakah bilangan prima kedua yang lebih besar dari 60?

questions.body_en:
A number multiplied by itself is called a Square Number. As shown below, 1, 4, 9, 16, … are square numbers. Find the sum of the first eight square numbers.
1 × 1 = 1
2 × 2 = 4
3 × 3 = 9
4 × 4 = 16
…
questions.body_id:
Sebuah bilangan yang dikalikan dengan dirinya sendiri disebut Bilangan Kuadrat. Seperti yang ditunjukkan di bawah ini, 1, 4, 9, 16, … adalah bilangan kuadrat. Temukan jumlah delapan bilangan kuadrat pertama.
1 × 1 = 1
2 × 2 = 4
3 × 3 = 9
4 × 4 = 16
…

questions.body_en: John left home for the park at 0730 h, at a speed of 60 m/min. His brother returned from the park at the same time at 70 m/min. It is known that the distance between the park and their home is 2600 m. At what time did they meet along the way? Give your answer in 24-hour clock format (e.g. 0612 h means 6:12 AM).
questions.body_id: John meninggalkan rumah menuju taman pada pukul 0730, dengan kecepatan 60 m/menit. Saudaranya kembali dari taman pada waktu yang sama dengan kecepatan 70 m/menit. Diketahui bahwa jarak antara taman dan rumah mereka adalah 2600 m. Pukul berapa mereka bertemu di perjalanan? Berikan jawabanmu dalam format jam 24 jam (misalnya 0612 berarti 6:12 pagi).

questions.body_en:
In Mathematics, 2¹ = 2, 2² = 2 × 2 = 4, 2³ = 2 × 2 × 2 = 8, ….
Study the pattern below carefully.
2¹ ÷ 3 = R2
2² ÷ 3 = 4 ÷ 3 = 1 R1
2³ ÷ 3 = 8 ÷ 3 = 2 R2
…
What is the remainder when 2¹⁰ is divided by 3?
questions.body_id:
Dalam Matematika, 2¹ = 2, 2² = 2 × 2 = 4, 2³ = 2 × 2 × 2 = 8, ….
Perhatikan pola di bawah ini dengan seksama.
2¹ ÷ 3 = S2
2² ÷ 3 = 4 ÷ 3 = 1 S1
2³ ÷ 3 = 8 ÷ 3 = 2 S2
…
Berapa sisa ketika 2¹⁰ dibagi 3?

questions.body_en: The 6th of February many years ago was a Wednesday during a leap year. On which day of the week was the 10th of March that same year?

questions.body_en: There are 8 steps on a flight of stairs at Don's apartment. There are 2 flights of stairs from one level to another. It takes Don 90 seconds to climb one flight of stairs. How many minutes does Don take to reach his home on the 6th floor?
questions.body_id: Ada 8 anak tangga di satu penerbangan tangga di apartemen Don. Ada 2 penerbangan tangga dari satu lantai ke lantai berikutnya. Don membutuhkan 90 detik untuk menaiki satu penerbangan tangga. Berapa menit Don butuh untuk sampai ke rumahnya di lantai 6?

questions.body_en:
Mother kept a birthday cake in the fridge in the morning. One of the children ate part of the cake in the afternoon. These were the answers when mother questioned them.
Alice: I didn't take the cake.
Benson: Mother, I didn't even know there was a cake.
Chloe: Benson took the cake!
Two of the children had lied. Who ate the cake?
questions.body_id:
Ibu menyimpan kue ulang tahun di kulkas pada pagi hari. Salah satu anak memakan sebagian kue di sore hari. Inilah jawaban mereka saat ibu menanyai mereka.
Alice: Aku tidak mengambil kue itu.
Benson: Bu, aku bahkan tidak tahu ada kue.
Chloe: Benson yang mengambil kue!
Dua anak telah berbohong. Siapa yang memakan kue itu?

questions.body_en: Find the area of the shaded region. [Hint: Area of triangle = ½ × base × height]. The figure shows a rectangle divided into two sections: the left section is 10 cm wide and the right section is 6 cm wide. The right section is a square (6 cm × 6 cm). A shaded quadrilateral is formed by connecting specific vertices across both sections.
questions.body_id: Temukan luas daerah yang diarsir. [Petunjuk: Luas segitiga = ½ × alas × tinggi]. Gambar menunjukkan persegi panjang yang dibagi menjadi dua bagian: bagian kiri lebar 10 cm dan bagian kanan lebar 6 cm. Bagian kanan adalah persegi (6 cm × 6 cm). Suatu bangun segi empat yang diarsir terbentuk dengan menghubungkan titik-titik tertentu pada kedua bagian.
